example.title: State Bridge No. 177, Brackenville Road over Mill Creek
example.place: Hockessin vicinity, New Castle County, DE

brief: Mid-19th-century single stone arch wagon bridge built with local labour and stone: a 20 ft segmental arch of rough split-stone voussoirs in coursed rubble spandrels and wing walls, with a carved date stone set in the face. The original stone parapet was removed in 1965 and replaced by a wider concrete deck with a concrete post-and-rail railing; W-beam guardrail on the approaches and a weight-limit sign. Narrow country road in dense woods over a rocky, boulder-strewn creek.

traits.railing_detail: concrete posts and rails (1965) on stone arch
